## About

I am a PhD candidate in Applied Economics at Oregon State University, where I study refugee policy, household welfare, and land use in Sub-Saharan Africa. My research uses spatial and panel data methods to examine the effects of Uganda's Open Door Policy on host and refugee communities.

I am on the job market in 2026–27. My job market paper studies the causal effects of refugee arrivals on food security, income, and crop prices in rural Uganda.

I am interested in remote positions, postdoctoral fellowships, and positions at institutions in the Pacific Northwest and West Coast.

## Research Interests

Development Economics &nbsp;·&nbsp; Refugee Policy &nbsp;·&nbsp; Land Use &nbsp;·&nbsp; Food Security &nbsp;·&nbsp; Spatial Econometrics
